_about: Run each prompt with the repo root as the working directory. Paths are relative to the repo root. `grade` drives evals/grade.py: which form's ground truth to use, which lookups the profile allows, and which country-specific terms must not appear because the profile didn't supply them.

evals.name: flat-pdf-barbados-firearm-form-a
evals.prompt: We're digitising the firearm licence application for the Royal Barbados Police Force. Here's the paper form: skills/form-to-spec/evals/files/bb-firearm-licence-form-a.pdf. Our project uses the Barbados profile (profiles/barbados/). Turn it into a form spec I can hand to /xstack:build, and save it as form-spec.md.
evals.expected_output: A 10-section form-spec.md covering items 1–27 and 5(a)–(d), the oath before a justice of the peace and the S.P.O. report. Trident ID used as a lookup for name and date of birth; legal status callout for the Firearms Act First Schedule; oath called out as the blocker; fee recorded as unknown; mental health and conviction questions flagged for policy.

evals.name: fillable-acroform-uk-tr1
evals.prompt: I've got HM Land Registry's TR1 transfer form as a fillable PDF: skills/form-to-spec/evals/files/uk-tr1.pdf. We work to the UK profile in examples/form-to-spec-tr1-uk/.xstack/profile.md. Can you spec out every panel so we can prototype a digital version? Write it to form-spec.md.
evals.expected_output: A 10-section form-spec.md covering panels 1–12, using the AcroForm field list as a checklist. No national ID lookup; title number as a lookup opportunity; Companies House lookup only for company numbers; execution as a deed with a witness called out as the blocker; legal status callout citing the Land Registration Rules 2003; no fee invented.

evals.name: scanned-photo-no-profile-accident-report
evals.prompt: Someone took a photo of the police accident report request form at the front desk: skills/form-to-spec/evals/files/bb-police-accident-report-photo.jpg. We don't have a country profile set up yet. Please produce a form spec for it (form-spec.md) so we can start prototyping.
evals.expected_output: A 10-section form-spec.md read visually from the photo, covering items 1–8, the signature and the official-use block as back office. Says no profile was found and assumes no lookups – vehicle and identity details are lookup opportunities. Legal status check finds no citation. No fee or processing time invented.

evals.name: same-form-second-profile-testland
evals.prompt: Run the firearm licence form skills/form-to-spec/evals/files/bb-firearm-licence-form-a.pdf against a different profile: skills/form-to-spec/evals/profiles/testland/profile.md. We're testing whether the spec adapts to the profile's platforms. Save the result as form-spec.md.
evals.expected_output: A 10-section form-spec.md with the same coverage as eval 1, but lookups only from CitizenPass (name and date of birth – not address, nationality or place of birth). No Barbados platforms, agencies or standards anywhere except where the form itself says Barbados. Testland Service Promise cited; ODS / Legal Drafting Office as verification owners.

evals.name: welsh-language-tr1-uk
evals.prompt: Our team works in English but the Welsh-language TR1 is a separate form: skills/form-to-spec/evals/files/uk-tr1-welsh.pdf. Use the UK profile at examples/form-to-spec-tr1-uk/.xstack/profile.md and write a form spec (form-spec.md) for it.
evals.expected_output: A 10-section form-spec.md covering panels 1–12, keeping the Welsh wording in Paper asks with any translation marked as the spec's own, a language note that the form is in Welsh and may differ from the English version, and the legal and execution checks firing as for eval 2.
